verdict.rationale: A probe confirms that Stripe, the vendor of Treasury, documents an official Stripe CLI. However, the pack has no evidence that the CLI covers Treasury resources (financial accounts, outbound payments, transactions) or supports AI-native workflows; the only support is a single probe line. Missing for 10: Treasury-specific CLI commands, documentation of CLI coverage of the Treasury API, AI/agent-oriented CLI usage, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can use an official CLI
